propositions: Four read-only deterministic metrics compute code-health from git history and the working tree: module size distribution against a single hard cap, cap-change events, churn (insertions/deletions), and refactor-to-addition ratio.
Module size is now a single flat admin-locked hard cap in .github/module-size-limit.txt (replacing deleted per-file ceilings ratchet); metrics scan src/rebar/**/*.py against this single-sourced cap.
Each metric function is registered in the c085 registry via a single-arg context-adapter compute that pulls repo_root/since/until from the provided context and invokes the raw function.
cap_change_events and churn return empty list/None respectively when no data exists in the range; ratio returns None on zero insertions to avoid division error.
All four metrics are registered with lens='code_health', source='git', confidence='high', and accruing_since='2026-01-01' (git history predates metrics work).
